events.name_en: An Ode for the Pure of Heart
events.name_jp: 純白の貴方へ、誓いの歌を！

changes.old: Uh, Toya... What did you mean when you said replacement just now?
changes.new: Uh, Toya... What did you mean when you said “replacement” just now?

changes.old: Also, I thought I heard his name just now...
changes.new: Also, I thought I heard “his” name just now...

changes.old: He was scheduled to be an extra for something today but he unfortunately has a stomach ache.
changes.new: He was scheduled to be an extra for something today but he unfortunately has a stomachache.

changes.old: It said, The director will give you more details the day of...
changes.new: It said, “The director will give you more details the day of...”

changes.old: At the end of this part, the minister for the wedding, the groom's friend, will say the standard to love and to cherish, till death do us part bit.
changes.new: At the end of this part, the minister for the wedding, the groom's friend, will say the standard “to love and to cherish, till death do us part” bit.

changes.old: The groom will say, I do, and just as the bride is about to say the same, a man will exclaim, Wait!
changes.new: The groom will say, “I do,” and just as the bride is about to say the same, a man will exclaim, “Wait!”

changes.old: He'll run up to the altar and spontaneously propose to the bride by shouting, I love you! Let's get married!
changes.new: He'll run up to the altar and spontaneously propose to the bride by shouting, “I love you! Let's get married!”

changes.old: The bride will then choose her groom by saying, He is the only one for me. Everybody else congratulates them with a hearty mazel tov...
changes.new: The bride will then choose her groom by saying, “He is the only one for me.” Everybody else congratulates them with a hearty “mazel tov”...

changes.old: You want us to take the reigns...?! You really can't send anyone else...?! But...!
changes.new: You want us to take the reins...?! You really can't send anyone else...?! But...!

changes.old: Yes. A wedding is a one-in-a-lifetime show in a way, you see?
changes.new: Yes. A wedding is a once-in-a-lifetime show in a way, you see?

changes.old: Since we're limited on time, we'll still go with when the bride and groom say their vows, but I'll making one small addition to that.
changes.new: Since we're limited on time, we'll still go with when the bride and groom say their vows, but I'll be making one small addition to that.

changes.old: They'll say, Oh, it was just an act, and feel relieved...?
changes.new: They'll say, “Oh, it was just an act,” and feel relieved...?

episodes.title_jp: 目の前のショーのために

changes.old: But to the bride and groom, this is a once in a lifetime event. If you're unable to see that, then I won't ask you to participate.
changes.new: But to the bride and groom, this is a once-in-a-lifetime event. If you're unable to see that, then I won't ask you to participate.

episodes.title_jp: エクストラウェディングショー！

changes.old: I'm finally done with everything dad asked me to do, so maybe I'll go to MEIKO's place and... Huh?
